svg.title: What the evidence supports—and what it does not establish
svg.desc: One claim is supported, one conditional, five mechanism-supported, one mixed, and six unsupported. The project does not estimate a national wage gap, representative prevalence, regression relationship, or causal effect.

g.text: What the evidence supports—and what it does not establish

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: The project supports bounded mechanism findings, not national or causal estimates

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Unit: adjudicated report claim • n = 14 • Evidence: final strict/bounded integration

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Inter', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Unsupported propositions remain explicit limitations rather than being rescued by evidence volume.
